description: This file contains test cases for silo shutdown scenarios in an Orleans distributed system, including tests for request forwarding, timer handling, and stuck activations during graceful shutdown of silos.

classes.name: ShutdownSiloTests
classes.description: Contains tests to verify the behavior of silo shutdown procedures, including request forwarding and handling of stuck timers or activations.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo with specific options, including Azure storage clustering and placement strategy.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Ensures that preconditions for running the tests (like Azure storage availability) are met before executing the test cluster.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with the number of silos and applies the silo configurator.

methods.name: ShutdownSiloTests
methods.description: Constructor for initializing test state, ensuring preconditions are met.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_ForwardPendingRequest
methods.description: Tests whether pending requests are forwarded correctly during silo shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_PendingRequestTimers
methods.description: Tests proper handling of timers during silo shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_StuckTimers
methods.description: Checks for appropriate handling when timers are stuck during shutdown.

methods.name: SiloGracefulShutdown_StuckActivation
methods.description: Verifies shutdown behavior when an activation is stuck.

methods.name: GetLongRunningTaskGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Retrieves a long-running task grain located on a secondary silo.

methods.name: GetTimerRequestGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Retrieves a timer request grain located on a secondary silo.
